text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — after the runtime bump I'm seeing intermittent 401s for streaming endpoints from our Go SDK when running in GH Actions. Suspect secret encoding/newline issue. anyone seen this?
Sam Ortiz: yup, sounds like a trailing newline in the secret. GH actions secrets often end up with a \n when copied. what client header looks like?
Maria Chen: here's what the header ends up as in the request debug (redacted):
```
Authorization: Basic dXNlcm5hbWU6c2VjcmV0Cg==
```
(the base64 decodes to `username:secret\n`)
Sam Ortiz: that trailing `Cg==` is 0x0A (LF) — that's the newline. streaming endpoints that validate the token strictly will reject.
dev-ci-bot: reminder: do not paste real secrets in public channels. use redacted values.
Alyssa Gomez: quick workaround in GH actions: when you set the secret in the workflow use `echo -n "$MY_SECRET" | gh secret set ...` or trim on read like `echo "$MY_SECRET" | tr -d '\r\n'` — avoids inserting newline.
Maria Chen: thanks — GH Actions UI copy/paste is the culprit here (I pasted from a note that had a trailing newline). Curious about SDK behavior: should the Go client auto-trim env var values before building `Authorization`?
Lee Park: avoid silently mutating secrets in the SDK. If an app wants to preserve spaces, trimming could hide bugs. Better: add a helper util in devex docs and an opt-in `NormalizeAPIKey()` helper in SDKs. Also log a warning when the header encodes a newline char (but don't send it).
Sam Ortiz: Agreed. For immediate fix we can: 1) update devex quicktip docs, 2) add a linter rule in our GH workflow job that checks secrets for trailing whitespace, 3) in SDK add a debug-mode validation that warns about non-printable chars in API key before sending.
Maria Chen: I'll open a tiny PR to the docs and add a GH workflow check (regex to detect `\n` or `\r` at the end).
Alyssa Gomez: Node folks — fyi `process.env.MY_KEY` will include the newline too. `fs.readFileSync(...)` vs env behaves same. For PowerShell users `Get-Content -Raw` may include `\r\n` depending on file. Use `.TrimEnd()` when reading from file.
Lee Park: for the SDK change, please don't change production path. Implement a `ValidateHeader()` that runs in `DEV` mode or when `REDCONF_STRICT_API_KEY_CHECK=true` and logs or returns an error. Add docs with examples: `echo -n`, `tr -d`, `strings.TrimSpace` cautions.
Maria Chen: noted. Will include example snippets for Bash, PowerShell, and GH Actions. tagging @Lee for review on the SDK helper PR once I open it.
Lee Park: 👍 lmk when it's up, I'll review.
Maria Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/412 (docs + GH workflow). thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: nice, will add the lint to the CI template in infra as a follow-up.
Alyssa Gomez: saved us from a few support tickets already :)
